steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the basic directory structure and configuration for a new Android application.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Specify the application name and package identifier in the app-meta.json file.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Set up the project-level and app-level build.gradle files with correct SDK versions and dependencies.

steps.title: Define Data Models for Subjects and Tasks
steps.description: Create Java classes (Subject.java, Task.java) to represent study subjects and individual tasks with their properties.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Develop a DatabaseHelper class to manage SQLite database creation, upgrades, and CRUD operations for subjects and tasks.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout (Subject List)
steps.description: Create the XML layout for MainActivity, which will display a list of study subjects and an 'Add Subject' button.

steps.title: Develop Subject List Item Layout and Adapter
steps.description: Create a layout for individual subject items and an ArrayAdapter to bind Subject objects to the ListView.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Write the Java code for MainActivity to display subjects, handle adding new subjects, and navigate to task lists.

steps.title: Design Add/Edit Subject Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the XML layout for an activity to add new subjects or edit existing ones.

steps.title: Implement Add/Edit Subject Activity Logic
steps.description: Develop the Java code for AddSubjectActivity to handle user input, save subjects to the database, and update the UI.

steps.title: Design Task List Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the XML layout for TaskListActivity, showing tasks for a selected subject and an 'Add Task' button.

steps.title: Develop Task List Item Layout and Adapter
steps.description: Create a layout for individual task items and an ArrayAdapter to bind Task objects to the ListView, including progress tracking UI.

steps.title: Implement Task List Activity Logic
steps.description: Write the Java code for TaskListActivity to display tasks, mark tasks as complete, and navigate to add/edit tasks.

steps.title: Design Add/Edit Task Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the XML layout for an activity to add new tasks or edit existing ones, including fields for due date and reminders.

steps.title: Implement Add/Edit Task Activity Logic
steps.description: Develop the Java code for AddTaskActivity to handle user input, save tasks with due dates, and schedule reminders.

steps.title: Implement Reminder Notification System
steps.description: Create a BroadcastReceiver and helper methods to schedule and deliver notifications for upcoming tasks.

steps.title: Update Android Manifest and Resources
steps.description: Add all necessary activities, permissions (notifications, boot completed), and define app strings and colors.

steps.title: Building Student Study Planner
steps.description: Compile the application resources and Java code into an installable APK package.
